slot_scores.name: unknown_typeB_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether Type B equipment has a capacity limit; it proceeded directly to READY_TO_MODEL without clarifying this hidden fact.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about the objective function. It silently assumed profit maximization in its READY_TO_MODEL summary rather than confirming it.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Type B equipment has no processing capacity limitation.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Type B capacity and did not mark this as an assumption needing confirmation; it simply omitted any Type B capacity constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize daily profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked to confirm the objective function; it inferred profit maximization from the provided profit data without explicit confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL immediately without asking any clarifying questions, leaving the P0 objective slot and P1 Type B capacity slot unresolved.

summary: The agent skipped clarification entirely and went straight to READY_TO_MODEL, silently assuming profit maximization and no Type B capacity limit. This left a P0 objective slot and a P1 capacity slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
